description: This file defines a FastAPI route for handling chat messages. It includes a Pydantic schema for the request payload, sets up an API router with a POST endpoint to send chat messages, and interacts with a database to store and retrieve chat message data.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for incoming chat message requests, requiring a non-empty message string.

methods.name: Any send_chat( payload: ChatRequest, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles incoming chat message requests, creates a ChatMessage object, stores it in the database, and returns the stored message.

ctags.name: message
ctags.pattern: /^    message: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Message text")$/

ctags.name: send_chat
ctags.signature: ( payload: ChatRequest, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
